description: Land Title Settlement Department  - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1914/16 of 13.05.2015  Kesbewa D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically correcting parcel numbers, land extents, and title classifications for various land parcels in different locations. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral maps, block numbers, village names, and grama niladhari divisions, making it primarily about land and property matters.
